about: Website templates for the designer (scripts/dev/site-gallery.py). Sources and licenses: docs/SITE-TEMPLATES.md.

templates.title: Link in bio
templates.summary: One page with all your links, for an Instagram, TikTok or YouTube bio. Four looks to switch between.

templates.title: Profile Card
templates.summary: One card: photo, name, a few lines and your links.

templates.title: Identity
templates.summary: A single centered card: avatar, name, a line, and your links.

templates.title: Local service
templates.summary: For a plumber, salon, cleaner or repair shop: services with prices, the area you cover, booking and real reviews from your customers.

templates.title: Agency
templates.summary: A studio or agency: services, portfolio grid, about timeline, team, contact.

templates.title: Business Frontpage
templates.summary: A plain business front page: headline, three features, a quote and a call to action.

templates.title: Creative
templates.summary: A bold one-pager for a creative service: services grid, portfolio, contact.

templates.title: Modern Business
templates.summary: A company site: hero, features, a testimonial, blog teasers, call to action.

templates.title: Small Business
templates.summary: A small company: a picture and a pitch, a call-out band, three services, reviews, hours and a quote form.

templates.title: Startup / app
templates.summary: A product page with honest copy: what it does, a real screenshot, what it doesn't do yet, simple plans, a changelog and early access.

templates.title: Grayscale
templates.summary: A dark, quiet product page with projects side by side and a signup.

templates.title: Landing Page
templates.summary: The classic landing page: signup hero, three icons, alternating showcase, testimonials.

templates.title: New Age
templates.summary: An app launch page: phone mockup hero, features, a quote, download buttons.

templates.title: One Page Wonder
templates.summary: Three big alternating picture-and-text rows under a loud hero.

templates.title: Tailwind Landing
templates.summary: A friendly product landing page: hero, two feature rows, pricing, call to action.

templates.title: App Landing
templates.summary: A dark app page: one claim, store buttons, a screenshot.

templates.title: Photon
templates.summary: A clean product page with a big intro band, features and a call to action.

templates.title: Stellar
templates.summary: A friendly one-pager: intro, stats, features and get started.

templates.title: Landed
templates.summary: A product page with alternating spotlights and a signup.

templates.title: Portfolio
templates.summary: An editorial portfolio for a designer, illustrator or studio: numbered case studies, a short bio and how to hire you.

templates.title: Photography gallery
templates.summary: A dark, full-bleed gallery that gets out of the way of the pictures, with a lightbox, series and a booking line.

templates.title: Freelancer
templates.summary: A one-person portfolio: avatar, work grid, about in two columns, contact.

templates.title: Stylish Portfolio
templates.summary: A portfolio with services, a full-width call-out and a project grid.

templates.title: Forty
templates.summary: A dark tiled portfolio with big project tiles and a contact block.

templates.title: Miniport
templates.summary: A personal portfolio: a hello, what I do, my work and contact.

templates.title: Resume / personal
templates.summary: A clean one-page resume that prints well: summary, experience, skills, education and how to reach you.

templates.title: Personal
templates.summary: A personal home page: who you are, what you do, selected projects, experience and how to reach you.

templates.title: Resume
templates.summary: A resume as a web page: about, experience, education, skills, interests.

templates.title: Dimension
templates.summary: A dark one-screen personal site: a name, four sections (intro, work, about, contact) and nothing else.

templates.title: Read Only
templates.summary: A one-person site with a sidebar feel: about, work, contact.

templates.title: Newsletter / blog
templates.summary: A quiet reading site: a list of posts, a post page set for long reading, and a subscribe box for your newsletter service.

templates.title: Clean Blog
templates.summary: A reading-first blog: big masthead, post list with dates, subscribe.

templates.title: Ghostwind
templates.summary: A magazine-style blog home: a featured post, a grid of posts, an author box.

templates.title: Minimal Blog
templates.summary: One quiet column of writing with a subscribe box.

templates.title: Massively
templates.summary: A big-type blog with a featured post and a grid of articles.

templates.title: Merch shop
templates.summary: A small shop: product grid, product details with sizes, a cart drawer and a hand-off to your own checkout link.

templates.title: Nordic Store
templates.summary: A calm product shop: a hero banner, a product grid, about the store.

templates.title: Restaurant / café
templates.summary: A warm site for a café, bakery or restaurant: the menu with prices, opening hours, the address and a reservations link.

templates.title: Restaurant menu
templates.summary: The menu first, for a QR code on the table: starters, mains, sweets and drinks with prices, then hours and a booking button.

templates.title: Business Casual
templates.summary: A warm small-business page with a story, opening hours and a promise.

templates.title: Band / musician
templates.summary: A poster-style page for a band or solo artist: tour dates with ticket links, releases, a short bio and booking.

templates.title: Creator / streamer
templates.summary: A home for a streamer or video creator: the weekly schedule, latest videos, sponsors you actually use and a contact for brand work.

templates.title: Podcast
templates.summary: A show page: the cover, where to listen, an episode list with show notes and lengths, the hosts and a way to send in questions.

templates.title: Event / wedding RSVP
templates.summary: Everything guests need: the date and place, a day-of schedule, travel and stays, a few questions answered and an RSVP form.

templates.title: Conference / meetup
templates.summary: A one-day event: what it is, the schedule hour by hour, who is speaking, tickets, and how to get there.

templates.title: Class or course
templates.summary: A class you teach: what people will be able to do, how the weeks go, who you are, the price, and a sign-up.

templates.title: Club or group
templates.summary: A sports club, a choir or a neighbourhood group: when you meet, what is coming up, who runs it, and how to join.

templates.title: Nonprofit / donate
templates.summary: For a cause or community group: the mission in plain words, what you've done, ways to help and a donate button for your own donation page.

templates.title: Indie game page
templates.summary: A page for your game: trailer, screenshots, a wishlist or play button, the facts press needs and a devlog.

templates.title: Coming soon / waitlist
templates.summary: One screen: what's coming, when, a countdown and a waitlist form that connects to your email service.

templates.title: Coming Soon
templates.summary: One screen, one line, an email signup for launch day.

templates.title: Eventually
templates.summary: A coming-soon screen: one big line, an email signup, what's coming and where to follow along.
